## About

I am a PhD student in mathematics at **National Taiwan University**, advised by **Professor Hui-Wen Lin**. My research interests include algebraic geometry, toric varieties, and Gromov–Witten theory.

I received my B.S. in Mathematics from National Taiwan University in 2024 and began my PhD studies in the same year.

::: {.research-line}
<span>Research interests</span>
Algebraic geometry · Toric varieties · Gromov–Witten theory 
:::

## Selected work

::: {.work-item}
<span class="work-year">2026 · PREPRINT</span>

### Quantum invariance under non-smooth toric flops of the simplest type

With Jia-Hua Chong and Hui-Wen Lin. For a non-smooth toric flop of the simplest type, we provide the quantum product formulas and construct the degree-preserving quantum correspondence via generalized analytic continuation which is achieved through a regularization map. Moreover, the generating functions of Gromov--Witten invariants with ancestors are invariant for all genera.

[Abstract & links →]https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.24066)
:::

::: {.work-item}
<span class="work-year">2024 · Math. Z. 313 (2026), no.3, Paper No.46</span>

### Fiber products under toric flops and flips

With Hui-Wen Lin and Sz-Sheng Wang.

[Abstract & links →]https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.12446)
:::
